name: toolshed
description: A personal Claude Code plugin marketplace. Publishes workbench, an SDLC toolkit (first tool: orchestrate-issues, which drives a GitHub issue dependency graph to completion with background agents). The doc-lifecycle plugin is paused; its source is retained for later repair.

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: An SDLC toolkit for Claude Code. First tool: orchestrate-issues, which drives a GitHub issue dependency graph to completion with background agents, one worktree and one reviewed PR per issue.
